title: Successive infinitesimal transition is a finite order thickening
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a scheme morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Put $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $n\ge0$, the canonical map $j_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ induced by $A/I^{n+2}\to A/I^{n+1}$ is a finite order thickening [def-sbc-first-order-thickening] and a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism].

proof.text: Apply quotientBaseChange_nestedIdeals to J=I^(n+2) and J'=I^(n+1). Its uniqueness clause identifies its closed immersion i with the displayed pullback.map, since both projection identities follow from pullback.map_fst and pullback.map_snd. Its kernel is the extension of J' along p ≫ f, where p is the projection X_(n+1) → X.

Write E(K) for the ideal sheaf of K on Spec A. The quotientBaseChange_closedImmersion_ideal formula identifies E(J).comap f with p.ker. Pulling back along p gives zero: comap_comp and comap_map_le applied to the bottom ideal show p.ker.comap p = bottom. The power clause quotientBaseChange_extendedIdeal_mul_pow gives i.ker^2 = E((J')^2).comap (p ≫ f). Since (J')^2=I^(2(n+1)) ≤ I^(n+2)=J, monotonicity of ideal extension and ideal-sheaf comap makes this square ≤ E(J).comap (p ≫ f)=bottom. Thus the square is bottom, giving an nth order thickening for n=1 and hence a finite order thickening.

Mathlib support_pow_succ and support_bot show that i.ker.support is the whole target. Hom.support_ker identifies this support with the closure of the image; the image of the closed immersion is closed, so its image is the whole target. Package surjectivity and apply the existing surjective-closed-immersion universal-homeomorphism instance.

lean.statement:
theorem infinitesimal_transition_thickening
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (n : ℕ) :
    let j := (pullback.map f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))
        f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) (𝟙 X)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
        (𝟙 _) (by simp)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
              Ideal.Quotient.factor_comp_mk]))
    IsFiniteOrderThickening j ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism j
